blocks.title: The tradition, crackling until closing time.
blocks.text: People come for it in the morning and stop by again on the way home. Golden crust, creamy crumb, and fresh batches until we close. Alongside it: seeded Nordik bread and big brioches for the weekend.

blocks.title: Butter, flaky layers, and the flan.
blocks.text: Croissant, pain au chocolat, red-striped raspberry croissant, pain aux raisins. And the flan pâtissier, tall and wobbly, which regulars buy by the slice or whole.

blocks.title: A quiche, a sandwich, back to work.
blocks.text: For everyone working nearby: quiches, baguette sandwiches, croque-monsieur and set menus with a drink. Order ahead and it's ready when you arrive.

items.a: Tuesday to Saturday, 7 am to 8:30 pm; Sunday, 7 am to 2 pm. Closed on Mondays. Holidays and exceptional closures are announced at the top of the site.

items.q: How far ahead should I order?
items.a: For bread, pastries and quiches, order online at least 30 minutes before you come. Cakes need 48 hours' notice, king cakes the day before. For a croquembouche, call us as early as you can.

items.q: Where can I find allergen information?
items.a: Allergens are listed on the labels in our counter. If you have an allergy, tell us at the counter or in your order notes and we'll answer product by product.

items.q: Do you make platters for offices?
items.a: Yes, on request: pastries, mini quiches, sandwiches and cakes for team breakfasts, meetings and drinks. Send us the date and number of people from the Platters page and we'll suggest a selection and a price.
Payment is made in store, when you eat in or collect your order. Meal vouchers (titres-restaurant) are accepted for lunch items.
Yes, there are a few tables. The breakfast deal (hot drink, orange juice, pastry) is €5.20, the brunch deal €11.80.

paris15.title: Bakery Paris 15
paris15.metaTitle: Bakery in Paris 15: baguette tradition, pastries, flan | Le Moulin de la Croix Nivert
paris15.metaDescription: A neighbourhood bakery in Paris's 15th arrondissement, rue de la Croix Nivert: baguette tradition, croissants, flan, quiches, cakes to order. Open until 8:30 pm, rated 4.5/5 on Google.
paris15.intro: A neighbourhood bakery in the 15th, open early and late, with everything you'd hope for: good bread, golden pastries and cakes for the weekend.

p: It's the product that comes up most in our reviews. A crust that crackles, a creamy crumb, and fresh batches into the evening for people who get home late.
Alongside the tradition: the classic baguette, seeded Nordik bread, brioches, and the bread of the day.
Croissants, pains au chocolat, pains aux raisins, raspberry croissants: that's the morning counter. In the afternoon, it's the flan pâtissier, éclairs, raspberry tartlets and macarons.
Tuesday to Saturday, 7 am to 8:30 pm. Sunday, 7 am to 2 pm. Closed on Mondays. To skip the queue, order online and collect at the time you choose.

cambronne.title: Bakery Cambronne
cambronne.metaTitle: Bakery near Cambronne metro: Le Moulin de la Croix Nivert, Paris 15
cambronne.metaDescription: A bakery 5 minutes from Cambronne metro (line 6), at 39 rue de la Croix Nivert: baguette tradition, pastries, quiches and lunch deals, open until 8:30 pm.
cambronne.intro: A few minutes from Cambronne metro, at the lower end of rue de la Croix Nivert. Morning bread, lunch at midday, a baguette for dinner.

p: From Cambronne station (line 6), it's about a five-minute walk. Commerce (line 8) and La Motte-Picquet–Grenelle (lines 6, 8, 10) are roughly the same distance.
Quiches, baguette sandwiches, croque-monsieur and deals with a drink, to take away. For a meeting or a team breakfast, ask for a platter of pastries or mini quiches.
We open at 7 am for coffee and a croissant, and close at 8:30 pm for the dinner baguette. The breakfast deal is €5.20.
